timeline.summary: Restaurant Brands Asia approved an investment of IDR 35,000 million in its subsidiary PT Sari Burger Indonesia via redeemable cumulative non-convertible preference shares.

Restaurant Brands Asia Limited invites investors and analysts to a conference call on May 15, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. (IST) to discuss Q4FY26 results, led by Rajeev Varman, Sumit Zaveri, Kapil Grover, Sandeep Dey, and Gaurav Ajjan.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹706.84 Cr (+11.7% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹43.01 Cr (against a loss of ₹56.28 Cr a year earlier).
Restaurant Brands Asia reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹7,068 Mn (+11.7% YoY) and added 4 stores QoQ to reach 581 stores in India.
Restaurant Brands Asia filed the Q4FY26 monitoring agency report showing ₹360.99 Cr utilised out of ₹500 Cr QIP proceeds.
Restaurant Brands Asia reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹706.84 Cr with SSSG at 6.3% and gross margin reaching 70.2%.
Restaurant Brands Asia received CCI approval on May 20, 2026 for its proposed preferential issue and change in promoter control.
QSR Asia Pte. Ltd. and its Persons Acting in Concert confirmed no encumbrance on RBA shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI SAST.
Restaurant Brands Asia published its pre-offer advertisement for the open offer at ₹70 per share plus interest, running from June 8 to June 19, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹844.85 Cr (+20.1% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹19.57 Cr (against a loss of ₹58.59 Cr a year earlier).
On 29 October 2026, Restaurant Brands Asia submitted monitoring agency reports regarding the utilization of QIP and preferential issue proceeds.
Restaurant Brands Asia Limited uploaded audio recording of investors and analysts call on 29 October 2026.
